name: Transmogrants
description: Chained fusions of dead flesh and metal that the Fallaji march to the attack.

timeline.summary: Soldiers gather to watch a column of chained transmogrants being marched to the front.
timeline.quote: Hideous, piteous things that were once human, now a rotting amalgam of flesh and machine.

timeline.summary: After a bombardment, the Fallaji wave charges across no-man's-land with transmogrants and finds the Argivian trench empty.
timeline.quote: They reached the Argivian trench and found it empty.
